description: Download an image or video from a public link into sprkly and get a media_id back, for reuse across several posts. You usually do NOT need this: sprkly_schedule_post accepts a link directly in media_urls and pulls it into storage itself whenever the target platform requires that. Reach for this tool only when the user wants one media_id to attach to more than one post. Google Drive and Dropbox share links are converted automatically; the file must be shared publicly. Limit 50 MB.

url.description: Direct https link to the image or video file. Must be publicly reachable.

name: sprkly_add_media_from_url
title: Add media from a URL
